description: Details pursuant to Conditions 3 (Construction Logistics Plan), 4 (Finished levels), 5 (Vehicle access), 6 (Samples of materials), 7 (Scheme of hard and soft landscaping), 9 (Landscape management plan), 10 (Scheme for storage and disposal of refuse/waste and vehicle access), 11 (Solar panel details), 12 (Fire safety statement), 15 (Green roof details and cross section), 16 (Boundary treatment details) attached to planning reference P/3467/22 allowed on appeal reference APP/M5450/W/23/3331571 dated 09/04/2024 for Three detached bungalows; Access Road; Enlargement of vehicle access
decision_conditions: <p>Insufficient information has been submitted relating to Condition 5 (Vehicle access), to demonstrate that the proposed modifications to the vehicle crossover are necessary and satisfactory with regards to design, materials and proposed use contrary to Policies M2(D) and M2(E) of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>Insufficient information has been submitted relating to Condition 7 (Scheme of hard and soft landscaping), to demonstrate that an acceptable quality of landscaping including adequate species has been provided, contrary to Policy GI4(A) of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>Insufficient information has been submitted relating to Condition 15 (Green roof details and cross section), to demonstrate that the proposed green roof is of acceptable quality, contrary to Policy GI4(A) of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
